name: XY Section demo: four units with a stairwell
abstract: A small test survey — four units on two floors with a stairwell spanning both, inside a lot parcel — shown as one plan section per floor, with rules that single out the stairwell and draw the lot as an outline.
description:
Demonstrates the **XY Section** view with rules as well as options.
Open the example below and choose its **XY Section** tab: one tab per floor, *Lower* and *Upper*.

The block's `resources` attach an [XY Section view configuration](bblocks://ogc.bbr.xysection.xySectionViewerConfig) (`viewer-config.json`) that:

- lists the **stairwell**, which spans both floors, as its own kind — dashed, in a fixed colour — and every other solid as a unit;
- draws the **lot parcel** flat as an outline on every floor, initially hidden (tick it in the layers panel);
- shows **lower floors** faded from the start, uses a **5 m grid**, and draws **no boundary**.

The document is the `4-unit-up-down-with-parcel.json` test survey, generated in the (private) `waTestData` repository and published here with permission.
Its lot boundary points have 2D `place` coordinates, which is enough for an outline.

examples.title: Four units up/down with a stairwell
examples.content:
Open the **XY Section** tab.
The document is the harness fixture `4-unit-up-down-with-parcel.json`, shared with the plugin's own tests.

annotatedSchema:
$schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema
title: Topo-feature document with floor levels
description: 'The minimum the XY Section view needs: `points` (with projected `place`
  coordinates) and

  `solids` (with floor levels). This is a demo block for the view, not a topo-feature
  schema; see

  https://github.com/ogcincubator/topo-feature for the data model itself.

  '
type: object
required:
- points
- solids
properties:
  points:
    type: array
    minItems: 1
  solids:
    type: array
    minItems: 1
